name: ChatWidget
label: AI chat
description: The whole AI chat: the panel, the streaming replies, the history, the cards and questions a reply can carry and the server handlers, set up with props.

props.name: fullscreenEnabled
props.description: Show the expand toggle. A host whose stage is always a takeover hides it.

props.name: closeEnabled
props.description:
Show the header's close button. A host that seats the chat as the page
itself rather than as a panel over one has nothing to close back to,
so it turns this off.

props.name: placementEnabled
props.description: Show the header's Chat position menu (dock right, dock left, floating). Off by default: a host turns it on only when it implements the seats the menu offers, as ChatLauncher does.

props.name: compact
props.description: Narrow insets for phone-width hosts.

props.name: phone
props.description:
The host is a phone viewport, where the soft keyboard will claim the
lower half of the screen the moment the composer is focused. The
welcome screen stacks instead of centring the composer: greeting in
the middle of the empty thread, starters directly above the composer,
composer pinned to the bottom from the first paint.

props.name: title
props.description:
The header brand name, which also seeds the agent's PixelAvatar.
Note: not the native `title` tooltip attribute; ChatWidget spreads no native attributes.

props.name: flow
props.description:
Which way the conversation reads. `top-down` (the default) floats each
new turn to the top of the thread and streams the answer in below it.
`bottom-up` is the classic message thread: turns stack from the bottom,
the newest just above the composer, and the view follows the answer.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The composer's placeholder text.

props.name: questionsPlaceholder
props.description: The composer's placeholder while a set of questions holds it: the answer goes in the card, or the card is skipped.
props.default: Answer the questions above, or skip them

props.name: showStarters
props.description: Show the conversation starters on the welcome screen.

props.name: logo
props.description: The header mark's image src; null (the default) shows the name alone.

props.name: tagline
props.description: The welcome screen's line under the greeting.
props.default: How can I help you today?

props.name: starters
props.description: The conversation starters: a few pre-written questions. Each must fit the chip budget (SUGGESTION_MAX_CHARS); one that does not is dropped rather than clipped.

props.name: startersKey
props.description: Keys the starters' staged reveal: a new key replays the generation beat, the same key shows the set standing. A host whose starters follow the page passes the pathname.

props.name: startersPending
props.description: Holds the starters' shimmer while the host is still writing them, for starters a model generates: the set reveals the moment this turns false, without the staged beat. Off by default.

props.name: composerActions
props.description: Replaces the composer's leading actions (the model picker).

props.name: models
props.description: The models the picker offers. The pick rides on each send as a wire value; the server resolves it. Omit for no picker.

props.name: defaultModel
props.description: The picker's selection before the server has reported its default. Defaults to the first model.

props.name: lockedModelDescription
props.description: The one line a locked model shows in place of its description.
props.default: Paused for today to stay in budget.

props.name: fileAttachments
props.description:
Let the visitor attach files: an attach button, paste, drop anywhere
on the chat, and long pastes folded into a tile. Files are read in the
browser for previews; what reaches the transport is names and kinds.

props.name: maxAttachments
props.description: Most files the visitor may queue on one message.

props.name: maxAttachmentBytes
props.description: Largest file the visitor may queue, in bytes.

props.name: mentions
props.description:
What the visitor can reference while typing: one source per trigger
character, drawn as tags in the composer and in the sent bubble.

props.name: threads
props.description:
A session-history rail. `true` seats the built-in ChatThreads over the
provider's thread lifecycle; a render prop seats your own. Wide hosts
seat it as an inline left rail, narrow ones summon it from a header
hamburger as a slide-over sheet behind a scrim.

props.name: threadsProps
props.description: Props for the built-in threads rail when `threads` is `true`.

props.name: tabs
props.description: An open-sessions tab strip as its own row under the header. `true` seats the built-in ChatTabs; a node seats your own.

props.name: tabsProps
props.description: Props for the built-in tab strip when `tabs` is `true`: its name, its close buttons' names and its spoken statuses.

props.name: aside
props.description: A companion rail on the trailing edge, the mirror of `threads`: a render prop for your own pane, seated inline on a wide host and raised as a bottom sheet from a header button on a narrow one. For the built-in pane pass `agent` instead.

props.name: agent
props.description: The built-in agent pane: who the agent is and what it has been doing. Seated like `aside`.

props.name: artifacts
props.description: Seat the artifact panel: a reply that carries an artifact draws a tile in the thread, and the tile (or the header's artifact button) opens the artifact beside the conversation on a wide host and as a bottom sheet on a narrow one. The trailing seat holds one panel at a time, so an open artifact stands in for the agent pane. Off, none of it exists: no header button, no tile, no panel.

props.name: context
props.description: What the chat is looking at, named on the composer's context note: a page, a selection, a passage. Omit for none. A host whose context follows the reader (rows they ticked, text they highlighted) updates it as they go, and can offer a way back and repeat it on each message sent.

props.name: contextClearLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the context note's clear button, shown when `context.onClear` is set. Defaults to "Clear context".

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: The composer's context note, naming what the chat is looking at.

props.name: contextPlacement
props.description: Where the context note sits: `inside` the composer, at the top of the shell, or `above` it as a bar of its own. Defaults to `inside`, the Composer's own default. A note alone never brings the composer's footer: with nothing else to seat there, it sits over the one-row composer.

props.name: contextNote
props.description: The composer's context note, written from `contextLabel`, for a host still on the label prop; `context` takes its `note` as a line.

props.name: attachHint
props.type: ((maxSize: string, maxFiles: number, maxBytes: number) => string)
props.description: The second line of the drop overlay with attachments on, written from the limits: the largest file as text ("50 MB"), the most files per message, and the largest file in bytes for a host that formats sizes itself. Defaults to `Up to <maxSize> each · <maxFiles> files max`.
props.defaultExpression:
(maxSize: string, maxFiles: number) =>
  `Up to ${maxSize} each · ${maxFiles} files max`

props.name: greetings
props.description: The welcome greeting for each part of the visitor's day; a key left out keeps its English. Defaults to "Good morning", "Good afternoon" and "Good evening".

props.name: placementLabels
props.description: The Chat position menu's rows, one per seat; a key left out keeps its English. Defaults to "Dock right", "Dock left" and "Floating".

props.name: agentStatus
props.description: The status line under the agent's name in the agent pane, where `agent` brings no `profile` of its own. Defaults to "Connected".

props.name: artifactPanelTitle
props.description: The artifact panel's title while nothing is on stage. Defaults to "Artifacts".

props.name: artifactEmptyTitle
props.description: The artifact panel's empty-state heading. Defaults to "Nothing here yet".

props.name: artifactEmptyDescription
props.description: The artifact panel's empty-state description. Defaults to "What the chat makes for you, like a dashboard or a page, opens in this panel."
props.default: What the chat makes for you, like a dashboard or a page, opens in this panel.

props.name: widgets
props.description:
A widget slot on the welcome screen, under the composer and its
starters. It takes any content and keeps its natural height, so the
composer rides up by half of it instead of holding dead centre: the
empty chat reads as a home page rather than a blank prompt. It leaves
with the first message, like the rest of the welcome dressing.

props.name: widgetsLayout
props.description:
How the widget slot takes its room. `fit` keeps the welcome screen to
one viewport: the widgets hold their height and the composer rides up
to make room. `scroll` turns the welcome screen into a page: the
greeting and composer take the opening of the viewport, the widgets
run on below the fold, and the whole welcome scrolls as one.

props.name: widgetsWidth
props.description:
How wide the widget slot runs. `column` holds it to the composer's
bounding box; `wide` lets it run past them, for a dashboard.

props.name: disclaimer
props.description: The quiet line pinned to the widget's floor: what the chat is and where its policy lives.

props.name: startersLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the welcome screen's conversation starters. Defaults to "Conversation starters".

props.name: newChatLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the header's new-chat button. Defaults to "New chat".

props.name: showAgentLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the agent-pane toggle while the pane is closed. Defaults to "Show the agent panel".

props.name: hideAgentLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the agent-pane toggle while the pane is open. Defaults to "Hide the agent panel".

props.name: closeAgentLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the agent pane's own close button, and of the scrim that closes the pane's bottom sheet. Defaults to "Close the agent panel".

props.name: showArtifactLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the artifact-panel toggle while the panel is closed. Defaults to "Show the artifact panel".

props.name: hideArtifactLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the artifact-panel toggle while the panel is open. Defaults to "Hide the artifact panel".

props.name: closeArtifactLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the scrim that closes the artifact panel's bottom sheet. Defaults to "Close the artifact panel".

props.name: placementLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the Chat position menu's button, and the heading of its group. Defaults to "Chat position".

props.name: enterFullscreenLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the expand toggle in panel view. Defaults to "Enter full screen".

props.name: exitFullscreenLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the expand toggle in full-screen view. Defaults to "Exit full screen".

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the header's close button. Defaults to "Close chat".

props.name: openThreadsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the header button that opens the chat-history sheet on a narrow host. Defaults to "Open the chat history".

props.name: closeThreadsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the scrim that closes the chat-history sheet. Defaults to "Close the chat history".

props.name: modelPickerLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the composer's model picker. Defaults to "Choose a model".

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the composer's send button. Defaults to "Send".

props.name: copyResponseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a reply's copy button. Defaults to "Copy response".

props.name: copiedResponseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a reply's copy button once the copy has landed. Defaults to "Copied".

props.name: copiedAnnouncementLabel
props.description: What screen readers hear once a reply has been copied. Defaults to "Copied to clipboard".

props.name: goodResponseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a reply's thumbs-up button. Defaults to "Good response".

props.name: badResponseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a reply's thumbs-down button. Defaults to "Bad response".

props.name: followupsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the follow-up question row under a finished answer. Defaults to "Follow-up questions".

props.name: pastedTextLabel
props.description: The name a long paste's tile wears in the composer and the sent message. Defaults to "Pasted text".

props.name: reasoningLabel
props.description: The reasoning disclosure's summary once the thinking is over, given the seconds it took when known. Defaults to "Thought for <n>s", or "Thought process" with no duration.

props.name: composerLabels
props.description: The composer's words, over Composer's English defaults: the attach button ("Attach files"), the drop overlay on the shell ("Drop files to attach"), the queued files' list ("Attachments") and their tiles (`attachmentTileLabels`), the stop button ("Stop generating"), the text field's name ("Message"), and the sentences announced when files or mention matches change. The send button's name is `sendLabel`.

props.name: attachmentDropZoneLabels
props.description: The drop overlay's headline when a file is dragged over the chat with attachments on, over AttachmentDropZone's "Drop files to attach". Its second line is `attachHint`.

props.name: attachmentGroupLabels
props.description: The words of the files on a sent message, over AttachmentGroup's English defaults: the list's name ("Attachments"), the overflow buttons ("Show 3 more", "Show fewer"), the tiles' status lines (`attachmentTileLabels`) and the viewer a pressed file opens in (`attachmentViewerLabels`).

props.name: chatThreadLabels
props.description: The conversation's names, over ChatThread's English defaults: the scrolling region ("Conversation") and the scroll-to-latest control ("Scroll to the latest message").

props.name: modelPickerLabels
props.description: The model picker's words, over ModelPicker's English defaults: the open list's name ("Model") and the trigger's text when nothing is selected ("Choose a model"). The trigger's own name is `modelPickerLabel`.

props.name: artifactPanelLabels
props.description: The artifact panel's words, over ArtifactPanel's English defaults: the view switch ("Preview", "Code", "Artifact view"), the expand and close buttons ("Expand the artifact", "Collapse the artifact", "Close the artifact") and the code view's CodeBlock (`codeBlockLabels`).

props.name: agentRailLabels
props.description: The agent pane's words, over AgentRail's English defaults: the tab strip's name ("Agent views"). The pane's close is `closeAgentLabel`.

props.name: questionCardLabels
props.description: The words of a question card a reply ends in, over QuestionCard's English defaults: the step count ("1 of 3"), the buttons ("Back", "Next", "Send", "Skip"), the records ("Skipped", "Not answered", "(chosen)"), the pick lines ("Choose one") and the "Something else" row.

props.name: questionSummaryLabels
props.description: The words of a sent set of answers, over QuestionSummary's English default: what stands in for a question left without an answer ("No answer").

props.name: codeBlockLabels
props.description: The words of a reply's fenced code, over CodeBlock's English defaults: the copy button ("Copy code", "Copy", "Copied"), and the code region's name, given the fence's language ("Code: bash", or "Code" with none).

props.name: promptSuggestionsLabels
props.description: The follow-up row's words, over PromptSuggestions' English default: the hidden text read after the sent suggestion ("(chosen)"). The row's name is `followupsLabel`.

props.name: transport
props.description:
Where the conversation goes. Defaults to the fetch transport against
`endpoint`, carrying the visitor's model pick. A script from
`scriptChat()` runs the widget with no backend at all.

props.name: endpoint
props.description: The endpoint the default transport posts to.

props.name: defaultPlacement
props.description: The seat the panel opens in.

props.name: followups
props.description:
Where follow-up questions come from after an answer commits: a source
function, an endpoint for the built-in fetcher, or `false` for none:
with `false` no chips show under an answer at all, not even the written
`fallbackFollowups`. Defaults to the fetcher against `/api/chat/followups`.

props.name: fallbackFollowups
props.description: The written questions offered when the source returns none or fails. Unused when `followups` is `false`.
props.defaultExpression:
[
  'Can you say more about that?',
  'What should I do next?',
  'Where can I read more?',
  'Can you give an example?',
  'What are the alternatives?',
]

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Where a thumbs verdict goes: a sink function, an endpoint for the
built-in poster, or `false` to hide the thumbs. Defaults to the poster
against `/api/chat/feedback`. Thumbs only ever show on a turn the
server logged (one with an exchange id).

props.name: renderers
props.description: Draws `card` events by kind.

props.name: artifactRenderers
props.description: Draws an artifact's preview by kind, for artifacts that are live React content rather than a document or a URL.

props.name: renderLink
props.description:
Renders a same-site link in an answer. The default renders through the
nearest LinkProvider's link component, else a plain anchor; passing
this wins over both.

props.name: isInternalHref
props.description: Which hrefs in an answer become links. Everything else renders as text.

props.name: threads
props.description: Seeds the thread lifecycle behind the `threads` and `tabs` slots.

props.name: placeholders
props.description: Replacement copy for the words the hook writes itself, merged over the English defaults: the status line of a reply that has not started ("Thinking") and the placeholder replies for an empty, stopped or failed turn.

props.name: label
props.description: The floating button's text.

props.name: icon
props.description: The button's icon.

props.name: summary
props.type: (AiButtonSummary & { chips?: { id: string; label: string; prompt: string; }[]; })
props.description:
A TLDR panel the button summons on hover: a pre-written summary and
prompt chips. A tapped chip opens the chat and sends the chip's
`prompt`. The launcher hands it to the closed button's AiButton, which
opens the panel on pointer hover; it does no device or hydration gating
of its own, so a host that wants the panel on hover-capable devices only,
or kept out of server HTML, passes `summary` only there.

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Render nothing at all: for routes that carry no chrome.
Note: not the native `hidden` attribute, which keeps an element mounted and only hides it; the launcher unmounts its button and panel, and spreads no native attributes.

props.name: panelId
props.description: The panel's DOM id, for a host control's `aria-controls`.

props.name: hostAttribute
props.description:
The attribute the launcher writes on `<html>` to say how the panel sits
(`docked`, `docked-left`, `takeover`), so the host's stylesheet can pad
the page or hide it. `false` writes none.

props.name: panelLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the panel.

props.name: aiButtonLabels
props.description: The words of the floating button's summary panel, over AiButton's English defaults: the panel's name, given the summary's title ("Summary: <title>"), its dismiss button ("Dismiss summary") and its chips' group ("Suggested prompts").

props.name: widget
props.description: Everything the widget takes. The launcher sets the responsive ones itself.

props.name: children
props.description: Rendered inside the panel after the widget: for a host's extra chrome.

props.name: surface
props.description:
How the docked panel sits on the page. `raised` (the default) is a glass
card with the floating shadow, inset by `--ds-chat-inset`. `inset` is
flat: the app surface colour, no shadow, border or blur, and the
`--ds-shell-inset` gap, so it matches AppLayout's `inset` content
surface beside it. The overlay below the dock threshold takes the same
gap but keeps its shadow, since it still covers the page; the floating
card and the takeover keep their own look.

props.name: overlay
props.description: The widget seated the rail as a sheet over the conversation rather than beside it.

props.name: close
props.description: Closes the sheet; a no-op on the inline rail.

props.name: logo
props.description: The brand row's mark, in both seats.

props.name: logoText
props.description: The brand row's text. Shown only on the sheet, where the chat header is hidden behind it; the inline rail leaves it out.

props.name: profile
props.description: The signed-in person, shown on the inline rail.

props.name: footerSlot
props.description: Rendered in the rail's footer in both seats (above the profile row on the inline rail; the sheet has none): a theme toggle, a link out. Fades out while the inline rail is collapsed.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Whether the inline rail can collapse to its icon strip.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description:
Whether the inline rail starts expanded. Defaults to `false`: it starts
collapsed to its icon strip. The sheet, and a rail that is not
`collapsible`, always show expanded.

props.name: historyLabel
props.description: Accessible heading over the history.

props.name: threadPanelLabels
props.description:
The words the ThreadPanel writes, merged over its English defaults: the
spoken pin and status text ("Pinned", "Working"…), each row's menu
trigger ("Thread options"), the rename field ("Rename thread"), the
projects header and its add button ("Projects", "New project"), and the
collapse toggle ("Collapse the panel", "Expand the panel"). The history's
own name is `historyLabel`.

props.name: actionLabels
props.description: The rows of each thread's menu, by action; a key left out keeps its English. Defaults to "Pin", "Unpin", "Rename" and "Delete".

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the tab strip.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of each tab's close button. A string is followed by a colon and the tab's title; a function is given the title and returns the whole name. Defaults to "Close chat".

props.name: statusLabels
props.description: Spoken text for each tab's status, merged over ThreadTabs' English defaults (Working, Unread, Needs input, Failed).

props.name: profile
props.description: The agent this pane belongs to: the portrait block at the top.

props.name: tabs
props.description: The panes, in display order: activity, approvals, automations, personalisation, or whatever the agent has.

props.name: value
props.description: The tab on stage, when the host owns the state; otherwise the pane keeps its own, seeded from `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The tab on stage first when the pane keeps its own state. Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the chosen tab's id.

props.name: activeTab
props.description: Legacy name for `value`.

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Legacy change callback; fires alongside `onValueChange`.

props.name: overlay
props.description: The widget seated the pane as a bottom sheet, where it fills the width instead of holding its own column.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fires from the pane's own close button, a cross in its top trailing corner. Omit for a pane with no close of its own.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the pane's own close button. Defaults to "Close the agent panel".

props.name: agentRailLabels
props.description: The words the AgentRail writes, merged over its English defaults: the tab strip's name ("Agent views").

props.name: artifact
props.description: The artifact on stage, or null for the empty state: the panel opened before the conversation has made anything.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the widget is showing the pane at its expanded size.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires with the next state from the expand toggle; omit where the seat has one size.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fires from the pane's close button; omit where another control closes the seat.

props.name: emptyPanelTitle
props.description: The panel's title while nothing is on stage. Defaults to "Artifacts".

props.name: emptyTitle
props.description: The empty state's heading. Defaults to "Nothing here yet".

props.name: emptyDescription
props.description: The empty state's description. Defaults to "What the chat makes for you, like a dashboard or a page, opens in this panel."
props.default: What the chat makes for you, like a dashboard or a page, opens in this panel.

props.name: artifactPanelLabels
props.description:
The words the ArtifactPanel writes, merged over its English defaults:
the view switch's segments and name ("Preview", "Code", "Artifact
view"), the expand toggle and close button's names ("Expand the
artifact", "Collapse the artifact", "Close the artifact"), and the code
view's copy button and region (`codeBlockLabels`).

props.name: artifact
props.description: The artifact this tile stands for.
